description:
Was a trade well executed? Give the token sold and bought, the amount sold, the amount received,
    the time (ISO such as 2026-10-27T18:05:00Z, or unix seconds) and optionally the venue. The trade
    is priced again on every venue from the pool reserves and order books read at the five-minute
    ticks either side of it (archive since 27 Oct 2026), by the same code as quote(), after network
    fees. Returns the venue that returned the most, how far the trade fell short of it in basis points
    (at the reading least favourable to that), and with venue given, how much of the gap was the
    choice of venue and how much the fill itself. Nothing is executed or stored.

amount_in.description: How much of the sold token went in, in its own units
amount_in.title: Amount In

amount_out.description: How much of the bought token came back, in its own units
amount_out.title: Amount Out

buy.description: Symbol of the token bought, e.g. USDCx
buy.title: Buy

sell.description: Symbol of the token sold, e.g. CC
sell.title: Sell

time.description: When the trade ran: ISO 8601 such as 2026-10-27T18:05:00Z, or unix seconds; the archive starts 27 Oct 2026 21:01 UTC
time.title: Time

venue.description: Optional: the venue it ran on, e.g. cantex, tradecraft, oneswap, temple, rocky or poolparty
venue.title: Venue

name: check_trade
title: Check a trade against every Canton venue at that time
